Restore from the row menu brought it back with its designations. Checkboxes with Archive and then Restore in the selection bar archived and restored two Documents. While the Contract was archived there was no Show archived or Upload, only Compare in row menus, and restore was refused with 409 until the Contract was restored. After another session restored a Document, Restore on the stale row showed "This document is not archived." and a reload showed it live. Delete opened "Delete this document?" naming the Document and its 3 versions; Delete stayed disabled until delete was typed and Cancel kept the Document. A rename while the dialog was open made the deletion refused. Typing delete removed the Document, its three Version downloads answered 404, no other Document became Primary, and the Contract activity still named it. Selection-bar Delete of two Documents also needed delete typed. An earlier Version's menu had no Delete and a single-Version delete answered 404. A Knowledge Item's Documents section archived and restored a Document, offered Set as primary and had no New folder.
